result.analyst_notes: Factual, corporate-voiced page led by business description and scale claims; values are mostly implicit. Commitments are hedged ('focused on', 'committed to') rather than absolute. Employees and shareholders appear only in one list. First-person plural 'we' and 'our' throughout. Safety is framed as a challenge. Customers, DEI and integrity are absent from the page.
